description: Requirements in, candidates out. Each material gets a verdict: pass (every constraint met by a sourced value), fail, or unknown (no data on a constraint, so it cannot be ruled in or out). Every constraint reports pass, fail or no_data and the strongest evidence level behind it (flown, measured, derived, inferred, estimated, predicted). By default only passes and unknowns are returned, passes first. Context narrows which values count: at_temperature (degrees C; values measured at another temperature do not count), flown_only (only values measured in the real space environment), environment, include_failed, limit. Materials with no data on any constraint are not listed: use what_is_missing to see coverage for one material.

constraints.description: The requirements a material must meet, each a property, an operator and a value

op.description: Comparison: at least, at most, equal to, or between value and value2

property.description: A registered property, for example density, yield_strength, max_service_temp (see list_properties)

unit.description: Unit of value, for example "kg/m3" or "ksi"; converted to the property's unit. Omit when value is already in the property's unit.

value.description: The number to compare against (in unit, or in the property's own unit when unit is omitted)

context.description: Optional narrowing of which values count and how many results to return

at_temperature.description: Degrees C; only values measured at this temperature count

flown_only.description: Only values measured in the real space environment

include_failed.description: Also return materials that fail a constraint

name: find_materials
title: Find materials that meet requirements
